# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Cap Kingdom Builder**, a Mario-inspired browser canvas platformer/course builder. Preserve the source mechanics: grid tile course data, tile types 1 solid / 2 hazard / 3 goal / 4 start / 0 erase, horizontal acceleration with friction and capped speed, gravity, grounded-only jump, AABB solid collision, smaller hazard hitbox, death plane reset, base64 import/export, story course list, editor tile painting, mobile left/right/jump controls, and win overlay on goal contact.

Transform the presentation into a cohesive playful platform fantasy: a red-capped cap hero, brick tiles, chomp hazards, cap start marker, golden flag goal, bright overworld hills, drifting clouds, retro UI panels, Press Start 2P HUD text, Bangers title display, compact GIF feedback, and approved catalog audio. Keep all code inline in `index.html` and prioritize mobile portrait actionability.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: 2D canvas platformer with a lightweight tile-course editor and base64 course sharing.
- objective: start from a placed start tile, traverse tile platforms, avoid spike/hazard tiles and falling below the death plane, and touch the goal tile to clear the course.
- input model: keyboard arrows/A-D/W-space plus mobile left/right/jump buttons; editor uses pointer paint/tap for tile placement.
- core loop: choose a story/import/editor course, spawn at start, move horizontally with friction and capped speed, jump only while grounded, collide against grid blocks, reset on death, show win overlay on goal contact.
- fail/friction state: spike contact or falling below y=2000 triggers death particles/audio/GIF and resets the player after a short delay.

## Protected Mechanics
- Tile codes are preserved: 1 solid platform, 2 hazard, 3 goal, 4 start, 0 erase.
- Physics constants, friction, grounded-only jump, AABB grid collision, precise 20x20 hazard hitbox, death plane, base64 import/export, story map, editor paint flow, and win overlay semantics remain intact.

## Remix Direction
A Mario-inspired platformer remix becomes **Cap Kingdom Builder**: a playful cap hero jumps through brick courses, avoids chomp-like hazards, starts from a cap marker, and tags a golden flag. Presentation is rebuilt with procedural canvas hills, bricks, cap hero, animated flags, chunky retro UI, catalog fonts, approved SFX, and mobile-safe controls while preserving the original platformer/editor rules.
